## load and read universal bank cvs

```

## Education dummy var 

```{r}
UVBank$Education_1 <- as.integer(UVBank$Education == 1)
UVBank$Education_2 <- as.integer(UVBank$Education == 2)
UVBank$Education_3 <- as.integer(UVBank$Education == 3)

```
## remove ID and zip code

```{r}
UVBank$ID <- NULL
UVBank$ZIP.Code <- NULL

```

## customer predictors_identifiers

```{r}
predictors <- c("Age", "Experience", "Income", "Family", "CCAvg",
                "Education_1", "Education_2", "Education_3", "Mortgage",
                "Securities.Account", "CD.Account", "Online", "CreditCard")


```
## prdictor creteria

```{r}
new_customer <- data.frame(Age = 40, Experience = 10, Income = 84, Family = 2,
                           CCAvg = 2, Education_1 = 0, Education_2 = 1,
                           Education_3 = 0, Mortgage = 0, Securities.Account = 0,
                           CD.Account = 0, Online = 1, CreditCard = 1)[, predictors]
summary(UVBank)
```

## 60/40 training 

```{r}
set.seed(1)
n <- nrow(UVBank)
train_UVB <- sample(n, 0.6 * n)
train <- UVBank[train_UVB, ]
valid <- UVBank[-train_UVB, ]


```
## scale

```{r}
scale_with <- function(df, ref) {
     mu <- sapply(ref, mean); sdv <- sapply(ref, sd)
     as.data.frame(sweep(sweep(as.matrix(df), 2, mu, "-"), 2, sdv, "/"))
}
conf <- function(actual, pred) table(Actual = actual, Predicted = factor(pred, levels = c(0, 1)))

     
```

## setup for knn Reference list: Anthropic. (2026). Claude Sonnet 5.5 [Large language model]. https://claude.ai, (Anthropic, 2026)

```{r}
library(class)
target <- "Personal.Loan"
```

## k = 1 (60/40)

```{r}
train_60 <- scale_with(train[, predictors], train[, predictors])
valid_60 <- scale_with(valid[, predictors], train[, predictors])
new_60   <- scale_with(new_customer,        train[, predictors])

prediction60 <- knn(train_60, new_60, cl = train[[target]], k = 1)
cat("k = 1 of new_customer:", as.character(prediction60), "\n\n")
```

## best k

```{r}
ks  <- 1:25
acc <- sapply(ks, function(k)
  mean(knn(train_60, valid_60, cl = train[[target]], k = k) == valid[[target]]))
print(data.frame(k = ks, valid_accuracy = round(acc, 4)))

best_k <- ks[which.max(acc)]
cat("\nBest k =", best_k, "\n")

p_valid <- knn(train_60, valid_60, cl = train[[target]], k = best_k)
print(conf(valid[[target]], p_valid))

cat("Best-k classification of new_customer:",
    as.character(knn(train_60, new_60, cl = train[[target]], k = best_k)), "\n")
```

## 50/30/20 partition

```{r}
set.seed(1)
idx  <- sample(n)
tr_i <- idx[1:(0.5 * n)]
va_i <- idx[(0.5 * n + 1):(0.8 * n)]
te_i <- idx[(0.8 * n + 1):n]

tr <- UVBank[tr_i, ]; va <- UVBank[va_i, ]; te <- UVBank[te_i, ]

tr_x <- scale_with(tr[, predictors], tr[, predictors])
va_x <- scale_with(va[, predictors], tr[, predictors])
te_x <- scale_with(te[, predictors], tr[, predictors])
```

## report

```{r}
report <- function(name, x, d) {
  p <- knn(tr_x, x, cl = tr[[target]], k = best_k)
  cat("\n.", name, "confusion matrix (n =", nrow(d), ", accuracy =",
      round(mean(p == d[[target]]), 4), "):\n")
  print(conf(d[[target]], p))
}

report("Training",   tr_x, tr)
report("Validation", va_x, va)
report("Test",       te_x, te)


```
